page_title: HeyGen: Create AI Videos with Your Personal Avatar

sources.entry: HeyGen.com - Effortlessly produce studio-quality videos with AI-generated avatars and voices.

summary.name: HeyGen
summary.one_liner: HeyGen is an AI video platform that creates videos with lifelike AI avatars, voice cloning, and translation from text, scripts, images, audio, or slides.
use_cases: Creating explainer and product demo videos
Translating and dubbing existing videos into other languages
Turning a script or slide deck into a narrated presenter video
Making social media clips with an AI avatar
Producing training and onboarding videos without filming
Converting podcasts or audio files into video
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Avatar V, a personal avatar model that generates video of a user's face and voice across different shots and languages, claiming consistent identity and phoneme-level lip accuracy in 175+ languages and dialects. Video Agent generates finished videos from a text prompt, with editable motion elements afterward. AI Studio is a text-based editor where tone, gestures, and emotion are controlled through the script, with collaboration, Brand Kit, and auto captions. Video Translation translates uploaded files or YouTube links with voice cloning and lip-sync. A set of AI tools covers text-to-video, image-to-video, audio-to-video, avatar creation, and PPT/PDF-to-video conversion.
notable: Avatar V personal avatar model using a reference video of the user
Text-based AI Studio editor for controlling delivery and gestures
One-click video translation with voice cloning and lip-sync across 175+ languages
Requires on-camera identity verification before creating a custom avatar
caveats: Paid plans unlock advanced features; the free plan supports text-to-video and AI video creation only
Custom avatars require on-camera identity verification of the person depicted
Content restrictions apply: no violence, political campaigning, or harm to minors
